incidents.summary: Fact load failed on first attempt with Oracle TNS listener unreachable. Root cause traced to scheduled DB host maintenance that did not include the listener in its restart playbook.
incidents.resolution: 1) Verified listener state with `lsnrctl status` on db-warehouse-prod-01.internal — listener was DOWN. 2) DBA team ran `lsnrctl start`. 3) Confirmed reachability with `tnsping warehouse_prod`. 4) Retried etl_load_facts via `sendevent -E FORCE_STARTJOB -J etl_load_facts`. Job succeeded in 1602s (normal). 5) Post-incident: DBA updated the maintenance playbook to include listener restart verification.

incidents.error_excerpt: ORA-01653: unable to extend table WAREHOUSE.FACT_TRANSACTIONS by 8192 in tablespace WAREHOUSE_DATA
incidents.summary: Fact load failed due to tablespace WAREHOUSE_DATA exhausted. Volume grew faster than monthly forecast.
incidents.resolution: DBA added 200GB to WAREHOUSE_DATA tablespace. Retried successfully. Capacity alarm threshold lowered from 90% to 80% in monitoring.

incidents.error_excerpt: ERROR: connection timed out to core-banking-api.internal:8443 after 120000ms
incidents.summary: Core banking API unresponsive during routine extract window. No corresponding outage on the source side — turned out to be a stuck connection pool on the ETL host.
incidents.resolution: Restarted etl-prod-01 connection pool service. Retry succeeded. Long-term fix: connection pool config tuned with shorter idle eviction.
